name: v2.1.0 - Notification System
body:
## What's New
- Real-time notification system with WebSocket support
- Dark mode toggle with system preference detection
- Improved OAuth callback handling
- Data export to CSV and JSON

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed race condition in auth flow
- Resolved pagination edge cases
- Fixed memory leak in notification listener

## Breaking Changes
None

## Contributors
@achen, @palves, @imartinez, @cdavis, @lscott
author: mbrown

name: v2.0.0 - Major Release
body:
## What's New
- Complete UI redesign
- New plugin architecture
- Performance improvements (40% faster load times)
- TypeScript migration complete

## Breaking Changes
- API v1 endpoints deprecated
- Config file format changed
